turns.name: Turn evidence list
turns.description: Compact list of collected turn evidence workspaces with inline keep/unkeep and delete row actions.

detailHeader.name: Selected turn header
detailHeader.description: Displays the selected turn question summary, turn key, status badge, and read-only record outputs.

diagnose.name: Diagnose this turn
diagnose.description: Start a new operations diagnosis session and submit the opening prompt for the selected turn evidence.

refreshTurn.name: Refresh evidence
refreshTurn.description: Re-collect evidence references for the selected turn.

keepTurn.name: Keep workspace
keepTurn.description: Mark the selected turn evidence workspace as kept to protect it from automatic cleanup.

unkeepTurn.name: Unkeep workspace
unkeepTurn.description: Remove the retention keep mark from the selected turn evidence workspace.

downloadTurn.name: Download ZIP
downloadTurn.description: Download the selected turn evidence workspace as a ZIP archive.

deleteTurn.name: Delete workspace
deleteTurn.description: Delete the selected turn evidence workspace after impact confirmation.

evidenceBanner.name: Evidence reference notice
evidenceBanner.description: Explains whether this workspace holds current runtime evidence references or needs refresh.

evidenceGaps.name: Evidence gaps
evidenceGaps.description: Lists missing evidence sources or collection warnings recorded for the selected turn.

evidenceRuns.name: Evidence runs
evidenceRuns.description: Lists runtime runs and artifact IDs referenced by the selected turn evidence package.

evidenceJson.name: Raw evidence references
evidenceJson.description: Formatted JSON snapshot of the resolved evidence references for inspection.

fileTree.name: Artifact files
fileTree.description: Directory tree of artifact files in the selected turn workspace loaded on demand.

fileViewer.name: Artifact file viewer
fileViewer.description: Renders the selected artifact file automatically as Markdown, JSON/code, CSV/TSV table, or plain text.
